utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa, I’ve got the repair drive pinned to the community center lot this afternoon, and I’m confirming the exact start time next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—that’s a huge help. Once you’ve got the start time, send it my way and I’ll update everyone for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I’ve still got it noted at the community center lot this afternoon, and I’ll send you the exact start time as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only know second-hand from Vik that it’s this Saturday afternoon, and Rosa’s the one organizing the volunteer spots and tool needs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, that matches what I’ve heard—it’s really picking up, and Mara’s got a sorting table set up, so folks can just bring their busted lamps and radios right over.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s good to know—I’d only heard Vik’s version, so I’m still catching up, but it sounds like Rosa’s got it coming together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tell Rey I’ve got the basic kit by Mara’s table, and I’m keeping the screws and patch supplies sorted so folks can jump right in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo—that helps. I’ve only got Sam on bike repairs and Lila bringing tools confirmed so far, so I’ll add your kit setup and keep checking with the others one by one.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—send anyone spare my way, and I’ll keep the kit, screws, and patch supplies ready at Mara’s table.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Cleo’s leading it, but I still need to double-check the start time; for now, just point me to the screws and patch supplies and I’ll get sorting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—before we lock anything in, can you confirm whether Cleo has the day set yet, or are we still leaning Saturday while you check the start time?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I don’t want to say for sure yet, but I think we’re still leaning Saturday while I check with Cleo on the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah—if you can confirm the start time, I can work it around school pickup on my end.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, start time. If we’re locking Saturday, does 10 in the morning still work, or did we already shift that?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Ten in the morning should work for me, as long as it still leaves enough time for school pickup later.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m aiming to get everyone set up by late morning, and I’ve got the tools covered. If anything shifts, I’ll let folks know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, that helps—if anything does shift, I can still send over a quick list from my basic toolkit and keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Appreciate that, Uli—late morning is still the plan, and your quick toolkit list would be handy just in case.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks—that late-morning setup helps. Just send me the final timing if anything shifts, and I’ll check it between stops.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fine, but I still need the full repair list and who’s covering each job—what’s still unassigned?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: From what I’ve got, Sam’s covering the wobbly chairs and busted lamp, and Gus is bringing tools for a late-morning setup; I’m still waiting on the full repair list to see what’s unassigned.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m putting the timing and sorting plan together this afternoon, Vik, and I’ll share it once it’s set so everyone has a clear schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Eli—it’s this Saturday afternoon, and I’ll keep telling everyone once you share the schedule so we get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that gives us a firm target—I’ll have the drop-off timing and sorting plan to you later today so you can spread the word clearly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll be there Saturday at 10 with my basic tools, and once the workspace is set I’ll start on the chairs and then check the lamp.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s lovely, Sam—Saturday at 10 should help things along nicely, and Mara’s setting up a sorting table so it ought to be easy to get started.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds perfect, Tess—I’ll head straight to the chairs once everything’s set up, and then I’ll take a look at the lamp.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m with you—until the date is locked and the job list is written out, I don’t want us counting on the repair drive too much.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Exactly—can we confirm the date first, and who’s actually bringing the tools before we rely on it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s what I need too—once the date is confirmed and we know who’s bringing the tools, I’ll feel a lot better about planning around it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going, and where can I jump in?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re set for Saturday at 10 by the community shed. Bring any basic tools you’ve got, and we’ll plug you in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll bring my basic tools and be there Saturday at 10; I’ll spread the word too in case a few more hands can make it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still leaning Saturday for the repair drive, though Sunday works for me too. If we lock Saturday in, we can move on to volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday at 10 by the community shed works for me—I’ll bring my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, let’s lock in Saturday at 10 by the community shed, then. I’ll start lining up volunteers next.
